forests.line: I've stepped in the middle of seven sad forests
stanza: Oh, where have you been, my blue-eyed son?
And where have you been, my darling young one?
I've stumbled on the side of twelve misty mountains
I've walked and I crawled on six crooked highways
I've stepped in the middle of seven sad forests
I've been out in front of a dozen dead oceans
I've been ten thousand miles in the mouth of a graveyard

forests.line: In the fields and in the forests
stanza: In the fields and in the forests
Under the moon and under the sun
Another summer has passed before us
